comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. GMOWidget::appendContextMenu builds the bank list by walking a table of banks, each entry carrying a category string, a file prefix and a display name; the categories are the four submenus. The maker's own one-line description in plugin.json says 'Lofi ROMPLER with only one bank of metal clangs', which is true only of the firmware the module starts on: the menu offers more than forty other banks.
